reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Detection and reconfiguration on changes to native network devices and their addresses is now the default", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; runtime device detection is now the default behavior.

proposed.statement: The Helm option enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and will be removed in a future release, because detection of native device and address changes is now the default.
